text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Agnes Tachyon has a track record.
Last year, and the year before that... Every time she visits the beach,
she conducts suspicious experiments over and over.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And this year, night after night, she has been spotted
entering this forest carrying laboratory equipment—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just what kind of terrifying scheme is she plotting this year?
As her Trainer, I must investigate—

text_block_list.name: Wild Boar
text_block_list.text: Bmoooooooooh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Heeey, Traaainer.
Yoo-hoo, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Honestly! Do you lack self-awareness as my guinea pig?! Wandering off wherever you please without my permission!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Hey... about that person who just walked into the woods.
Isn't that the famous Trainer around the academy?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that person who glows sometimes!
They even had a headlight on, but...
they're already glowing, so isn't that kinda pointless?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Glowing... Oh, it's you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...If I recall, near the forest research camp,
there are large wild animals—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Where am I?
After running around trying to escape that wild boar,
my stamina has finally reached its limit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My consciousness fades—and what comes rushing back
are my memories with Agnes Tachyon—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"And so, my dear guinea pig.
—My mistake, rookie Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"—By the way, how are you feeling right now?
Considering your hair literally just turned light blue."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Have you not noticed?
...You are glowing. In a yellow-green light.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Come to think of it, it's always been like this.
Yet strangely enough, I have no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I might have just been a guinea pig—
but even so—for the sake of her dream—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—...Good grief.
So this is where you were.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: If only I had some smelling salts or cold water to revive them... Nothing else for it, I'll have to use this...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Are you awake, Trainer-kun?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
......
What's the matter? No excuse to offer?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Leaving my side without permission, that is.
I don't recall releasing you from your cage.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, coming out to such a dangerous area... You must have a pretty serious reason, right? Hmm?
What is it? Go on, speak up, don't hold back.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Please make sure something like this doesn't happen again.
After all—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"After all, you are... an indispensable guinea pig
for my experiments."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—On another note, how are you feeling?
Do you feel energy coursing through your body?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it—
I feel like my vision has gotten brighter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as if one's heart were filled with Agnes Tachyon's kindness, illuminating the world in sight with light—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...No, that's not it! They're physically glowing!
They are glowing like crazy! My own legs!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaa! Success!!
My research here has finally borne fruit!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"How about that, Trainer-kun!
You can feel the overflowing energy, right?!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I wanted to experiment as soon as possible, but then you up and vanished on me! You have no idea how anxious I was while searching for you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Just how much running potential is hidden within those brilliant legs...! Without a doubt, this is a major milestone in my research!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"No, reaching this point was only possible thanks to being blessed with such an exceptional test subject.
I truly am a fortunate researcher."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...And so. Based on the results obtained this time,
I plan to launch a new research project, but—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! That's my Trainer-kun!
I knew you'd say that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...It can't be helped. Being by her side means accepting things like this, after all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —From now on too, surely. Forever.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then. I'm sure you're itching to test its effects yourself.
Go on, take a run right away!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Since it's glowing anyway,
I'm gonna give the photosynthesis boost
to the trees deep in the forest that lack sunlight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And... I simply ran. As if the uneven ground
and dense trees didn't even exist,
freely and fast, wherever I wished.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...As an aside, the light racing freely through the woods
was witnessed by the students at the training camp,
and apparently became a local legend.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
By the way, I put in some sugar cubes
to make it go down smoother. How was it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, I had no clue what was going on,
and the concern itself was a mystery... but either way, I tried nodding.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Now that's strange.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I hardly think that tiny amount of sugar would change
the flavor so drastically... A chemical reaction with the medicine's ingredients, perhaps? Hmm, intriguing—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I wanted to ask why she brought it up only to
drop it, but in the end... I let it go."
